name: ConnectSFU
tagline: One hub for campus club events, with buddy matching for students and attendance stats for clubs.
problem: Club events are scattered across social media, chat and email, so students miss them.
solution: Students browse featured events, find a buddy to go with and explore clubs; club admins create events and see sign-up stats; Gemini powers descriptive search.
demo_moment: Team-described: search for an event by description and find a buddy.

why_it_stood_out.claim: Serves both students and club organisers.

lessons: Two-sided campus tools win when both sides get something on day one.
